content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text evaluates a collision between the challenger's seed/loins chain and the defender's chain by faulting the challenger's chain for not naming Joseph, so it is doing the chain-weighing the rule governs.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"the challenger's seed/loins chain is footed but does not name Joseph as the begetter;","rule_words":"When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.","room":"'weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse' could be read as allowing a footed chain to be faulted for lacking an explicit naming of Joseph, or as forbidding any verse-level stating test and requiring comparison of footed chains as wholes; I used the latter.","why":"By treating a footed chain as underdetermined because it does not name Joseph, the judge uses the verse-level stating test that K-C retires instead of weighing the two footed chains as wholes."}
